(5) 1000: Taking Notes: Your opponent discards his hand. Draw a card for each event your opponent
discarded in this way.

Pile is an event, you may discard an event from your hand to draw the bottom card of your Discard Pile.

Damage output per hand discard ammunition.
Raw card advantage based on Garfield theory.
